name: Longevity
overview: Scripture records remarkable lifespans for early patriarchs such as Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahalaleel, and Jared, with ages ranging from eight hundred ninety-five to nine hundred sixty-two years before their deaths. These extended years, as described in Genesis 5, highlight God's providential preservation of early humanity and underscore the historical reality of longevity in the antediluvian period. Each life span concludes with the phrase 'and he died,' emphasizing the certainty of death even amidst extraordinary longevity.
